source.prompt: Deep house song, about 3.5 minutes, 121 BPM, C minor. Dreamy, velvety late-night mood, slow and sensual. Smooth, airy female lead vocal with soft layered harmonies on the chorus. Warm analog synth pad, mellow grand piano chords, soft Rhodes, deep rounded sub bass, airy flute-like synth lead. Smooth four-on-the-floor kick, soft closed and offbeat open hats, gentle shaker, no hard snares or plucks. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, smooth, wide mix with a tight mono low end.

[Intro]
Ah, ah

[Verse]

Velvet shadows on the stair
You said stay, I said I might
